  • Field Details

    • log

      private static final org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger log

    • VALID_NAME_PATTERN

      private static final Pattern VALID_NAME_PATTERN
      Pattern for a valid header field name.

      Deliberately conservative (letters, digits, and hyphen only) rather than the full RFC 5322 ftext range, so malformed or attacker-crafted lines (e.g. plain body text that happens to contain a colon) are rejected rather than captured as a header under an unexpected name.

    • EXTENDED_VALUE_PATTERN

      private static final Pattern EXTENDED_VALUE_PATTERN
      Pattern for the RFC 2231 extended-value shape: charset'language'value. The language tag may be empty (e.g. UTF-8''value).

    • getDecodedValue

      public String getDecodedValue()
      Gets header value with RFC 2047 encoded-words (e.g. =?UTF-8?B?...?=) decoded to readable text.

      getValue() deliberately returns the raw wire value untouched (needed for signature verification and faithful pass-through); use this method when a human-readable value is wanted instead, such as for display or reporting.

      Falls back to the raw value if the header contains no encoded words, or decoding fails (e.g. an unsupported or malformed charset).

      Returns:
      Decoded header value.

    • getExtendedParameter

      public String getExtendedParameter(String name)
      Gets an RFC 2231/5987 extended parameter (e.g. filename*=UTF-8''%C3%A9vil.exe), decoded to its actual value.

      Handled separately from getParameter(String): the star form's charset'language'value shape doesn't tokenize correctly under the generic parameter parser, since the single quotes are themselves token delimiters.

      Only the single-segment form is supported, not the name*0*/name*1* continuation form for values split across multiple parameters.

      Parameters:
      name - Base parameter name, without the trailing * (e.g. "filename").
      Returns:
      Decoded parameter value, or null if the extended form isn't present.

    • percentDecode

      private static String percentDecode(String value, String charset)
      Decodes a percent-encoded (%XX) string. Unlike URLDecoder, a literal + is left untouched rather than turned into a space, matching RFC 2231.
      Parameters:
      value - Percent-encoded value.
      charset - Charset to decode the resulting bytes with.
      Returns:
      Decoded string, or the original value if the charset is unsupported.
